'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Justin Montgomery DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Montgomery]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Username:''' cardlicker
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
